run_GetTestsForAllIterations: run the test program and return a list of tests executed per iteration
run_GetTestCases: run GetTestCases to extract unique test case names from a list of full test names
run_RandomSeedFlag: run RandomSeedFlag to generate a gtest random seed command line flag for a given number
run_FilterFlag: run FilterFlag to generate a gtest filter command line flag for a given test filter pattern
run_ShuffleFlag: run ShuffleFlag to generate the gtest shuffle command line flag for test shuffling
